mapping.summary: MCP connector letting Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot and other AI agents work in BC.
claims: Connects BC to any AI platform supporting Model Context Protocol via a secure MCP server
Works with Claude, ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot
AI can look up and analyse BC data
AI can carry out approved actions such as creating sales documents and posting invoices
AI works within BC permissions; admins can restrict fields
Every call made through the connector is visible to admins
Partners and ISVs can expose their own extension capabilities to connected AI
Use cases include building reports by plain-language request
Can assist data migration from older NAV, BC or other ERPs
Can be used for automated testing before releases
Add-on apps extend it with banking, document exchange, storage, routines and language models
